issues.issue: Was the applicant denied procedural fairness because the officer did not consider his extension request (January 2, 2020 email)?
issues.applicant_position: He emailed an extension request on January 2, 2020, and his affidavit and Gmail printout show it was pending, so ignoring it breached fairness.
issues.respondent_position: IRCC never received the January 2 email; the Thyriar affidavit shows no such email in its inbox; applicant has not proved receipt.
issues.result_text: Applicant did not prove the extension request was before the officer; no procedural fairness breach.
No argument that the Decision was unreasonable; the findings suffice to dismiss the application.
